description: Verify that DUT accepts a UDP datagram with a well-formed UDP Header (RFC 768 'Format' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The positive baseline for UDP receipt: when src_port, dst_port, Length, and Checksum are all well-formed and the IP envelope is valid, DUT must deliver the datagram to the upper-tester. This case anchors the negative-discard cases (FIELDS_08..10/15, INVALID_ADDRESSES_01/02, DATAGRAMLENGTH_01) by showing the same path delivers correctly when the header is right.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: UDP datagram with a well-formed header

2. Observation:
   • DUT's upper-tester receives the datagram (UT-query confirms)

[Pass condition]
UT-query confirms DUT delivered the well-formed UDP.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_receipt — DUT did not deliver a well-formed UDP (drop path overzealous)
• Fail_timeout — UT-query never arrived (test infra issue)

verdicts.Pass: DUT accepted the well-formed UDP — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_receipt: DUT did not accept the well-formed UDP
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No UT confirmation for well-formed UDP accept
